sources.title: Distributed Stochastic Gradient Descent With Staleness: A Stochastic Delay Differential Equation Based Framework
sources.relevance: SDDE and characteristic-root optimization of worker number, group size, staleness threshold, and communication protocol for shared-model ASGD.
sources.not_the_gap: Does not provide a pairwise policy-dependency cache graph for distinct Markov-game policy blocks.

sources.title: Distributed Stochastic Optimization with Random Communication and Computational Delays: Optimal Policies and Performance Analysis
verification: identified by the TSP article as its earlier conference version
sources.relevance: Earlier SDDE/Langevin analysis of stochastic-gradient noise and staleness.
sources.not_the_gap: Shared optimization parameter and global scheduling rather than distinct interacting policies.

sources.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: Asynchronous Communication and Linear Function Approximation
sources.relevance: Asynchronous low-communication cooperation with linear function approximation and regret guarantees.
sources.not_the_gap: Parallel agents solve one common linear MDP; no pairwise strategic-staleness graph among distinct policy blocks.

sources.title: Asynchronous Actor-Critic for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
sources.relevance: Asynchronous action selection and learning with temporally extended actions.
sources.not_the_gap: Execution-time action asynchrony rather than training-time mixed policy-version caches.

sources.title: Dynamic Coordination Graph for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
sources.relevance: Dynamically generated coordination graph for joint-value factorization.
sources.not_the_gap: Graph structures action-value factorization, not policy-version refresh during asynchronous training.

sources.title: HyperMARL: Adaptive Hypernetworks for Multi-Agent RL
sources.relevance: Addresses cross-agent gradient interference and specialization under parameter sharing.
sources.not_the_gap: Architectural parameter generation rather than delayed cache synchronization under a communication queue.

sources.title: Distributed Online Learning for Joint Regret with Communication Constraints
sources.relevance: Adapts graph partitions under asynchronous activations, delays, and communication constraints in online convex learning.
sources.not_the_gap: No Markov-game trajectory law, distinct policy-gradient dependencies, or controlled cache-reset SDDE.
